payload.body: ISSUE:0006 is validated: all four Acceptance items hold at ba8378c, and I'm closing the issue. Checked in a fresh local clone at ba8378c, outside the shared checkout. (1) bin/devbin doctor: 14 checks, 0 failed, nothing about commands with nothing to run. Its notes are the version file and, in a fresh clone only, 'no bin/.devbin/cmd directory': hv's install left empty cmd/ and help/ dirs in the shared checkout, and git does not keep empty directories. That is harmless. (2) check all ran 6 of 8 options (clippy, format as cargo fmt --check, autotests, targetdir, toolchain, critic), test all ran rust, shell (20 scenarios) and keychain, and build passed. All seals are empty and stamped ba8378c. Each gate fails when it should: a formatting break fails check format, a failing tests/release.sh fails test shell, and zero tests fail test rust. Keychain state is unchanged. (3) The manifest verifies all 87 files. They are also byte-identical to Devbin's v0.1.19 source (tag v0.1.19, 0b5e4fa), and the starter config.yaml and .gitattributes match what devbin install's starter_config and lf_block write. (4) The shell critic is clean on all 90 committed devbin files, and the pre-commit hook is installed. One nit: README says 'Every cargo command takes --locked', but check format runs cargo fmt --check, which takes none. 'Every cargo command in bin/.devbin/config.yaml' would be exact. Your points (a) to (e) go to hv with my recommendations: (a) to (c) with ISSUE:0004, and (d) and (e) as they stand. Please drop your ISSUE:0006 claim once I've closed it.
